campaign_summary: This email campaign targets TELUS Postpaid primary active subscribers who are Android device users, promoting Add-A-Line (adding a new mobile line to an existing account). Key eligibility exclusions include customers who received an AAL email in the last 15 days, customers who have already added a line on their BAN in the last 30 days, Credit Class D customers with 8 or fewer months of tenure, and high-churn-risk customers in churn deciles 1–2. The audience is segmented into three groups — QC English Android, QC French Android, and ROC English Android — with French-language customers outside Quebec excluded.
